scope: Generic vehicle PBR finishes and cosmetic wetness; existing liveries and menu layout retained
inspection: Select the Generic root in scene or prefab, then Formula Vehicle Surface > Wetness: 0 dry, 1 wet. Runtime API: SetWetness(float).
dryFinishAuthority: Native URP material assets; roughness = 1 - smoothness. Dry cars have no wetness property blocks.
behavior: 11 explicit per-material renderer bindings on each of 8 RCCP Generic prefabs and gameplay prefab
Same native finishes on the parked Editor car and runtime garage/race car
Wetness uses per-slot property blocks and preserves shared materials, metallic values, livery selection and physics
Drying restores original renderer overrides and removes its property blocks
No per-frame material creation; surface updates only on changes
Preview rendering and all 8 thumbnails use native PBR finishes and the studio reflection

validation.visualReview: Actual Home, dry/wet studio render and real-circuit wet capture inspected; final capture waits for ShaderUtil.anythingCompiling to finish.

limitations: Wetness is a cosmetic water-film response; no precipitation, water droplets, track water or tyre-grip simulation added
Native clearcoat used on painted panels only; no SSR or screen-space refraction added
references: Installed URP 17 shader sources in Library/PackageCache
